description: STRICT regression gate for the nightly Hallie replay. Every entry is a live miss from Rick's own sessions whose corrected behaviour was fixed AND pinned by unit tests on the date given. Expectations are CONSTRAINTS on the corrected behaviour — route, outcome, required or forbidden text — never the text of the previous wrong answer and never a whole expected sentence. A defect flag on any entry fails the strict verdict; the 345-question hallie_eval_corpus.json stays advisory. Chains marked followsPrevious replay in one session (no :reset between them). Add an entry only after the fix has a unit test; remove one only with the commit that removes the behaviour. Fields the grader honours: expectedRoutes, expectedOutcome, mustContain, mustNotContain, mustMatch, mustMatchQueryDescription, mustMatchAttachmentOutline (codex #1190).
